result.summary: Found 1 critical content issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed instead of a section title.

issues.description: The section header displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the translated/human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you'). This indicates a broken or missing string translation.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' is mapped to an actual translated string in the language resource files, and add a fallback so raw keys never render to users.
